minutes.headline: Agricultural Commission voted in officers, then walked part of it back; clerk and vice chair to be redone next meeting.
minutes.summary: The commission held a reorganization by roll call, discussed the economic development committee seat that calls for a business owner, and heard the farmers market report. Ongoing items covered a public market law, holding land, and the farm acreage bylaw. Members were unhappy they were not told about a hydroponic lettuce greenhouse proposal, an alternate applicant was invited back, and the vice chair and clerk posts were left to be re-voted.
